name: Dead Acre
summary: The Dead Acre lies burned and abandoned in southeastern Westfall, near the bridge to Duskwood. The Defias Brotherhood torched the farm during their uprising, and rogue harvest golems now stalk its blackened fields.

sections.title: Ashes on the Border
sections.body: You find the Dead Acre just north of the road from Sentinel Hill to Duskwood. Once a productive homestead among Westfall’s breadbasket farms, it met a violent end when the Defias Brotherhood rose in revolt and drove out the local landowners. The farm and its crops went up in flames. Scorched timber and smoking earth remain, while mechanical Harvest Watchers still reap the barren soil.

faq.q: Why is this place called the Dead Acre?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood burned the farmstead and fields when they took control of Westfall. Blackened ruins and smoldering earth gave the farm its grim name.

faq.q: Why are mechanical Harvest Watchers wandering here?
faq.answer: Mechanical reapers built to tend Westfall’s crops were left behind when settlers fled or died. Without caretakers or corrupted, the Harvest Watchers still patrol the burned fields and attack anyone who comes near.

faq.q: Where is the Dead Acre located?
faq.answer: The Dead Acre lies in southeastern Westfall, just north of the main road near the bridge into Duskwood.

angles.text: The Dead Acre recalls Stormwind’s neglect of Westfall, which left loyal farmers defenseless against the Defias Brotherhood’s violence.
